title: Battery voltage before switch
description: Essential: Student correctly states or uses that the battery voltage is U = I(R1 + R2) = 2IR.

title: Equivalent resistance after switch
description: Important: Student calculates the equivalent resistance after closing S as R_eq = R1 + (R2||R3) = R + R/2 = 3R/2.

title: Main circuit current after switch
description: Important: Student applies Ohm's law to find the new total current I' = U / R_eq = (4I)/3.

title: Current division for R2
description: Essential: Student correctly uses current division in the parallel branch to find the final current through R2 as I'_2 = I' / 2 = (2I)/3.

title: Units and symbolic answer
description: Optional: Student presents the final answer clearly as a multiple of I (e.g., (2/3)I) and/or includes proper units.

title: Incorrect parallel resistance
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly calculates the parallel combination of R2 and R3 (e.g., as R or 2R).

title: Ignoring voltage constancy
description: Pitfall: Student assumes the battery current I remains constant instead of recognizing the battery voltage is constant.
